  admitted negative informational result corrects expectation without changing history.

  eventually remove the target candidate. The fixed-seed run reaches this change;
  the analytical probabilities, chosen actions and updates are all preserved.
- Changing only hidden reward while holding reports fixed preserves all safe output
  bytes. The labelled CurrentRewardOnly comparator fails this boundary.
- Withheld corrective evidence leaves expectation unchanged. Unobserved training
  produces actual actions without admitted history; false positive reports can train
  tendency despite unrewarded physical outcomes. Unknown differs from known negative.
- The same learned history does not activate the target under the untrained cue once
  expectation is neutral. Cue folds are independent in this finite domain.
- ExplicitBeliefOnly and NoHistory lose the corrected target candidate immediately;
  they cannot explain the acquired-history contrast under equal current belief.
- Residual and Linear are serious alternatives. After three positive observations
  their tendencies are7/8 and3/4; after one negative action result,7/16 and1/2. With the
  candidate threshold1/2, they predict different later availability and probabilities.
